subject: maths
question: Rakesh can do a piece of work in 45 days and Manoj can do the same work in 90 days. Find the time required to complete the same work if they work on alternate days and Rakesh starts the work.
solution:
**Given:**

Rakesh can do the work in 45 days

Manoj can do the work in 90 days

**Concept:**

Work done in one day = 1/Time taken to complete the work

When they work alternately, the time taken to finish the work will be twice the harmonic mean of their individual times.

**Solution:**

⇒ Work done by Rakesh in a day = 1/45

⇒ Work done by Manoj in a day = 1/90

⇒ Time taken when they work alternately = 2/(Work done by Rakesh in a day + Work done by Manoj in a day) = 2/((1/45) + (1/90)) = 60 days

**Therefore, if Rakesh and Manoj work on alternate days starting with Rakesh, they can finish the work in 60 days.**
